A noise at the front door pulls me from the first bit of rest I’ve been able to obtain since my eyes closed late last night.
lines.zh: 前门传来的一声响动，把我从昨晚闭上眼以来唯一得到的一点休息里拽了出来。

lines.en: I don’t have it within me to open them and find out who it is that may be coming to either greet me or chop my body into pieces and, honestly, I’m not sure which of those I’d even prefer right now.
lines.zh: 我没有力气睁开眼去看看，来的人是要跟我打招呼，还是要把我砍成几块——说实话，我现在也不确定自己更想要哪一种。

lines.en: I know you’re probably thinking it’s a bit too early for fatalism...and that I should just tear myself away from this much-needed slumber to either fuck or fuck off, but fuck you.
lines.zh: 我知道你大概觉得现在谈宿命论太早了点……还觉得我应该把自己从这场急需的睡眠里扯出来，去操或者滚蛋，但操你的。

lines.en: Christmas is over. The beach trip is over. And without any idea of what to look forward to or {i}when{/i} to look forward to it, this unfamiliar bed is nothing more than a chamber I can lock myself into stasis with.
lines.zh: 圣诞节结束了。海滩之旅也结束了。在不知道该期待什么、也{i}不知{/i}何时该期待的情况下，这张陌生的床不过是一个能让我把自己锁进去休眠的房间。

lines.en: Wake me up when this is all over- for I suddenly remember what it’s like to dream.
lines.zh: 等这一切结束再叫醒我——因为我突然想起来做梦是什么感觉了。

lines.en: And I don’t like it.
lines.zh: 而我不喜欢。

lines.en: I don’t like it at all.
lines.zh: 我一点也不喜欢。

lines.en: : {i}Makoto! What are you doing?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Makoto！你在干什么？{/i}

lines.en: : What does it look like I’m doing? I’m going to wake him up. That’s why we came here, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我看起来像在干什么？我要把他叫醒。我们来这儿不就是为了这个吗？

lines.en: : {i}Well...yes. But to traipse right on over to him without any regard for his personal space is rather...rude. Don’t you think?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯……是。但就这么径直走过去、完全不顾他的私人空间，未免有点……失礼。你不觉得吗？{/i}

lines.en: : Does he even have any personal space {i}left{/i} after haphazardly distributing it between all twenty of us?
lines.zh: : 在他把私人空间草率地分给我们二十几个人之后，他还{i}剩得下{/i}什么私人空间吗？

lines.en: : Mm. I suppose that is a fair point.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我认为这是个合理的观点。

lines.en: : Very well. Proceed. But know that I will not be able to help you if you are dragged under the covers in a fit of lustful, delirious rage.
lines.zh: : 很好。继续吧。不过你要知道，要是你在充满欲望、神志不清的暴怒中被拖进被子里，我可帮不了你。

lines.en: : I think I’ll manage.
lines.zh: : 我想我应付得来。

lines.en: The sensation of a fingertip repeatedly prodding at my cheek makes it clear to me that I am not about to be murdered or chopped up or whatever it is I {s}said{/i} thought before.
lines.zh: 指尖反复戳我脸颊的感觉让我明白，我不会被谋杀、被砍成几块，或者像我之前{s}说{/i}想的那样随便怎样。

lines.en: It’s unfortunate, really. For the last twelve or so hours and all of the thoughts and feelings brought on by them have reminded me of how much I hate feeling anything in the first place.
lines.zh: 真是遗憾。过去这十二个小时左右，以及随之而来的所有思绪和感受，都在提醒我，我有多讨厌去感受任何东西。

lines.en: scene christmasyay
This graphic becomes relevant again.
lines.zh: 这个画面又派上用场了。

lines.en: : Hey. You. Wake up.
lines.zh: : 嘿。你。醒醒。

lines.en: While it may not be the season anymore, I have a hard time believing its aftertaste will be departing my metaphorical tongue any time soon.
lines.zh: 虽然季节已经过了，但我很难相信它的余味会在短期内从我隐喻的舌头上退去。

lines.en: If only there was another that could coat mine with foreign saliva and a taste reminiscent of something more enjoyable.
lines.zh: 要是能有另一个人用异样的唾液涂满我的舌头，留下一种类更令人愉悦的味道就好了。

lines.en: Something like watermelon.
lines.zh: 比如西瓜味。

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup1
But I suppose I’ll have to settle for this instead.
lines.zh: 但我想我只能将就一下了。

lines.en: It’s just unfortunate since her spit is the only thing I {i}haven’t{/i} taken from her yet and watching her cling to her last bit of freedom has been nice thus far.
lines.zh: 只是有点可惜，因为她的口水是我唯一{i}还没{/i}从她身上拿走的东西，而看着她死守着最后一点自由，到目前为止还挺有意思的。

lines.en: All good things come to an end, I guess.
lines.zh: 天下没有不散的筵席，我想。

lines.en: : Oh, good. You’re alive.
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了。你还活着。

lines.en: : Barely.
lines.zh: : 勉强。

lines.en: : Long night?
lines.zh: : 昨晚很漫长？

lines.en: : Something like that.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。

lines.en: : Does it have anything to do with all of that crumpled up paper on the table?
lines.zh: : 跟桌上那堆皱巴巴的纸有关系吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. Decided to leave the beach early so I could grade all of the assignments Imani has been giving you. I’m turning over a new leaf.
lines.zh: : 对。我决定提前离开海滩，好把 Imani 一直在布置给你们的作业批改完。我要洗心革面了。

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup2
: Mhm. And I’m suddenly a lesbian.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。那我突然变成一个女同性恋了。

lines.en: : Congratulations, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你，Makoto。

lines.en: : Bite me.
lines.zh: : 咬我啊。

lines.en: : Um...good morning, Sensei. I’d ask if you slept well, but...I get the feeling that was not the case.
lines.zh: : 嗯……早上好，Sensei。我本来想问你睡得好不好，不过……我感觉答案是不太好。

lines.en: : And I get the feeling that I am waking up a lot later than normal right now.
lines.zh: : 而我感觉自己现在醒来的时间比平时晚了很多。

lines.en: : Last I checked it was about...1:00 PM. So I figured it would be best if I were to come here myself and make sure you were sleeping and not...well, dead.
lines.zh: : 我上次看时间大概是……下午 1 点。所以我觉得最好还是自己过来一趟，确认你是在睡觉，而不是……嗯，死了。

lines.en: : Why would you bring Makoto here if my death was a real possibility in your mind?
lines.zh: : 既然你心里真的觉得我可能会死，那你为什么还要把 Makoto 带到这儿来？

lines.en: : I obviously wouldn’t have been able to carry your body myself. You are exceedingly large for a Japanese man, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我显然一个人搬不动你的尸体。你作为日本男人来说体格格外庞大，Sensei。

lines.en: : Those papers...what are they?
lines.zh: : 那些纸……是什么？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup3
: They’re obviously not our assignments. And considering I haven’t seen you so much as {i}lift{/i} a pen in what feels like years, I’m a little...confused.
lines.zh: : 它们显然不是我们的作业。而且考虑到我感觉好像有好几年没见你{i}拿{/i}起笔了，我有点……困惑。

lines.en: : You haven’t started writing again, have you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会又开始写作了吧？

lines.en: : I don’t see why it matters.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得这有什么要紧。

lines.en: : It matters because it’s a substantial change in what I would call an...incredibly predictable life pattern.
lines.zh: : 要紧，因为这是对我所谓……极其可预测的生活模式的一次实质性改变。

lines.en: : That paired with the fact that you disappeared for an entire night suggests something big might have happened in-
lines.zh: : 再加上你消失了整整一夜，这暗示着可能发生了什么大事-

lines.en: : Now, now, Makoto. I’m sure Sensei was just bored from having to spend the night in a brand new place without any of his...uhh...{i}belongings.{/i}
lines.zh: : 好了好了，Makoto。我相信 Sensei 只是因为要在全新的地方过夜、身边又没有他的……呃……{i}私人物品{/i}，觉得无聊罢了。

lines.en: : Belongings?
lines.zh: : 私人物品？

lines.en: : Are you talking about porn?
lines.zh: : 你是在说色情杂志吗？

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup4

: N...No! Though, I will admit that I am at least partially regretful in regard to not providing some sort of comparable...stash of magazines, as I am acutely aware of the male tendency to hide such material.
lines.zh: : 不……不是！不过，我承认我至少有点后悔没有提供某种类似的……杂志储备，因为我非常清楚男性有藏这类东西的倾向。

lines.en: : There’s still time to right your wrongs, Touka.
lines.zh: : 现在弥补你的过失还来得及，Touka。

lines.en: : I’d really rather not.
lines.zh: : 我真的不想。

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup5
: Sensei, seriously. If you’re actually writing again, that’s a big step. And it’s one that I think we should talk about as it’s one of the reasons I always looked up to you in the first-
lines.zh: : Sensei，说真的。如果你真的又开始写作了，那是一大步。而且我觉得我们应该谈谈，因为那是我最初敬仰你的原因之-

lines.en: : Drop it, Makoto. If I want to talk to you, I’ll talk to you. But I am currently in the process of waking up after maybe one hour of sleep and I just...don’t feel like it right now.
lines.zh: : 别说了，Makoto。如果我想跟你说，我会说的。但我现在正处于大概只睡了一个小时之后醒来的过程里，我……现在就是不想谈。

lines.en: scene black
There’s a moment of silence as Makoto and Touka both cease conversation and stare at me like I’m some sort of caged animal or art installation.
lines.zh: 一阵沉默，Makoto 和 Touka 都不说话了，盯着我看，好像我是什么笼中兽或者艺术装置。

lines.en: But as I lean up in bed, they’re reminded that I’m only slightly less human than the two of them- and they bring themselves to their feet as I do my best to mimic that.
lines.zh: 但我从床上坐起来的时候，她们想起我也只是比她们俩稍微不那么像人一点——于是我努力模仿着站起来，她们也跟着站了起来。

lines.en: The feeling of the bedroom’s tatami on my soles startles me at first due to the night and day contrast between that and the cold, hard wood I’ve grown accustomed to.
lines.zh: 卧室榻榻米贴着我脚底的感觉起初让我一惊，因为它和我早已习惯的冰冷坚硬的木头形成了昼夜般的反差。

lines.en: Each of them sense this and take a half-step forward to try and catch me in the event that I fall before realizing that they’re just being overly-cautious.
lines.zh: 她们两个都察觉到了，各自向前迈了半步，准备在我摔倒时接住我，随后才意识到自己只是过分小心了。

lines.en: It’s annoying having people who care about you so much.
lines.zh: 被人这么关心真烦。

lines.en: Though, I assume I wouldn’t be quite as annoyed if I understood why they’d want to prevent me from falling in the first place.
lines.zh: 不过，我想如果我能理解她们为什么想阻止我摔倒，我就不会这么烦了。

lines.en: Some people are just naturally kind, I suppose.
lines.zh: 有些人大概天生就善良吧。

lines.en: I wonder what that’s like.
lines.zh: 我想知道那是什么感觉。

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup6
: Is something wrong, Makoto?
lines.zh: : Makoto，有什么不对吗？

lines.en: : Hm? No. That painting just looks...eerily familiar.
lines.zh: : 嗯？没有。那幅画看起来……出奇地眼熟。

lines.en: : That’s likely because it was created by the same artist who painted the one I gifted you last Christmas.
lines.zh: : 那大概是因为它出自去年圣诞节我送你的那幅的作者之手。

lines.en: : Oh, good. So now {i}Sensei{/i} has a near-priceless piece of art. What a great person to trust with such an important item.
lines.zh: : 哦，好啊。现在{i}Sensei{/i}也有一幅价值连城的艺术品了。把这么重要的东西托付给他，真是再好不过了。

lines.en: : Don’t be ridiculous. That one is a mere replica worth only a tenth of the original’s value.
lines.zh: : 别荒谬了。那幅只是复制品，价值只有原作的十分之一。

lines.en: : And where is the original? Your bathroom?
lines.zh: : 那原作在哪儿？你的浴室？

lines.en: : My dorm room, actually. You should come visit one day. It would be nice having someone else to keep an eye on Yasu from time to time.
lines.zh: : 在我的宿舍房间，其实。你哪天该来看看。时不时有别人帮我盯着 Yasu 一点也不错。

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup7
: Am I visiting as a {i}friend{/i} or a babysitter? Because that greatly influences my answer.
lines.zh: : 我是以{i}朋友{/i}的身份去做客，还是去当保姆？因为这极大地影响我的回答。

lines.en: : Is my apartment your new hang-out spot or something? Are you two just going to chat here while I go on with my day?
lines.zh: : 我的公寓成了你们新的据点还是什么？你们俩打算就在这儿聊，而我继续过我的日子？

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup8
: Oh, sorry. I forgot your self-esteem crumbles any time you’re not the center of attention.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。我忘了只要不是众人焦点，你的自尊心就会崩塌。

lines.en: : Sensei does make a good point, though. It is quite rude for the two of us to make plans without him while we’re guests in his home.
lines.zh: : 不过 Sensei 说得有道理。我们俩作为客人，在他家里当着他的面做计划，确实挺失礼的。

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup9
: Don’t you literally own the building?
lines.zh: : 这栋楼不就是你家名下的吗？

lines.en: : It is probably best if we do not discuss which buildings I do and do not own. I would not like to make anyone feel insignificant in the face of my family’s vast sphere of influence and wealth.
lines.zh: : 我们最好还是别讨论我名下有没有哪些楼。我不想让任何人因为我家族那庞大的影响力和财富而觉得自己微不足道。

lines.en: : Yeah...it might be a little too late for that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这可能有点太晚了。

lines.en: : So...question. What did you tell everyone when I disappeared last night? Because there’s no way our...{i}prolonged absence{/i} went unnoticed.
lines.zh: : 那么……问个问题。我昨晚消失的时候，你跟大家怎么说的？因为我们的……{i}长时间缺席{/i}不可能没人注意到。

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup10
: I’m not really a fan of the way you said {i}prolonged absence{/i} right there...
lines.zh: : 我不太喜欢你刚才说{i}长时间缺席{/i}的方式……

lines.en: : It’s true that our absence was noted by several of the girls who tend to keep a closer eye on you, but I’m sure I needn’t remind you I wasn’t the girl you {i}initially{/i} ran off with.
lines.zh: : 几个平时比较留意你的女孩确实注意到了我们的缺席，这没错。但我想我不必提醒你，我可不是你{i}最初{/i}私奔的那个女孩。

lines.en: : Yeah...and what happened to her as well?
lines.zh: : 是吗……那她后来怎么样了？

lines.en: : Who is “her?” Who are you running around with now?
lines.zh: : 「她」是谁？你现在跟谁混在一起？

lines.en: : I’m afraid that’s confidential, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 恐怕这是机密，Makoto。

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup11
: Yeah...what else is new?
lines.zh: : 是啊……又来了。

lines.en: : I’m actually quite surprised to find out that she didn’t wind up here as well, considering she never made it back to the inn last night.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我很惊讶她居然没有跑到这儿来，毕竟她昨晚根本没回旅馆。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : There’s no need to worry, though. Both Ayane and Ami have been in contact with her and she is fine.
lines.zh: : 不过不用担心。Ayane 和 Ami 都跟她联系过，她没事。

lines.en: : In regard to {i}your{/i} disappearance, you’ll be pleased to know that I handled it to the best of my ability and that there was only {i}one{/i} search party that sprouted up as a result of your disappearance.
lines.zh: : 至于{i}你{/i}的失踪，你会很高兴地知道，我已经尽力处理了，而且因为你的失踪只{i}冒出了一支{/i}搜查队。

lines.en: : Oh, good. That’s not nearly as bad as it could have been.
lines.zh: : 哦，好啊。那还不算太糟。

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup12
: Some say that Ami is {i}still{/i} out there to this day...
lines.zh: : 有人说 Ami{i}到今天{/i}还在外面找……

lines.en: : The day has barely changed, Makoto...
lines.zh: : 这一天还没怎么变呢，Makoto……

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i} I believe this is the part where you praise me for both my reliability and proactivity.
lines.zh: : {i}咳。{/i}我想这部分你该称赞我的可靠和主动了吧。

lines.en: : As if Sensei is going to praise anyone for literally any-
lines.zh: : 好像 Sensei 会称赞任何人做任-

lines.en: : Great job, Touka. You’re a real life saver.
lines.zh: : 干得好，Touka。你真是我的救命恩人。

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup13
: Ah!
: Hey! What the fuck?!
lines.zh: : 嘿！什么鬼？！

lines.en: : You said my real name and everything!
lines.zh: : 你连我的真名都叫出来了！

lines.en: : Praise me now! I’ve done way more for you than Touka has!
lines.zh: : 快夸我！我为你做的可比 Touka 多多了！

lines.en: : Makoto, she bought me an apartment.
lines.zh: : Makoto，她给我买了一套公寓。

lines.en: : Yeah, and I've...done things I can't repeat out loud! How much more do I have to do until that's worth an apartment?!
lines.zh: : 是啊，我还……做了一些不能大声说出来的事呢！我到底还得做多少，才能抵得上一套公寓？！

lines.en: : Fine, here. You’re very smart and very pretty and I’d be nowhere without you. Happy?
lines.zh: : 行，给你。你非常聪明，非常漂亮，没有你我什么都不是。满意了？

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup14
: M...Maybe.
lines.zh: : 也……也许吧。

lines.en: : Do you have any other questions, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你还有别的问题吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Yeah. What did you tell everyone exactly?
lines.zh: : 有。你到底跟大家怎么说的？

lines.en: : That you had an important business meeting.
lines.zh: : 说你有一个重要的商务会议。

lines.en: : In the middle of the night on Christmas?
lines.zh: : 在圣诞节的半夜？

lines.en: : That’s just how important the meeting was.
lines.zh: : 就是重要到那种程度。

lines.en: : And people actually believed it?
lines.zh: : 而大家真的信了？

lines.en: : Oh, not at all. But just knowing that you were safe seemed to be enough for most of them.
lines.zh: : 哦，完全没信。但光是知道你安全，对大多数人来说似乎就够了。

lines.en: : Apart from the one search party, that is. Which still contained roughly half of the class. But seeing as you’re still alive and well, I’d say everything worked out just fine!
lines.zh: : 除了那支搜查队。那里面差不多有半个班的人。不过既然你还活蹦乱跳的，我觉得一切都还算顺利！

lines.en: : It might be good to lay low for a while, though. Ami is very mad.
lines.zh: : 不过你最好还是先低调一阵子。Ami 非常生气。

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : Anyway, do you mind if I make a phone call? There’s someone I should probably, uhh...follow up with.
lines.zh: : 总之，我打个电话你们介意吗？有个人我大概该，呃……跟进一下。

lines.en: : Go right ahead. Makoto and I will step out onto the balcony once she regains her senses.
lines.zh: : 请便。等她回过神来，我和 Makoto 就去阳台上。

lines.en: scene black
scene makototoukawakeup15
: Huh?
scene makototoukawakeup16
: Uhh...hi?
: {i}Why do you sound so concerned?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你听起来怎么这么担心？{/i}

lines.en: : Because you’re calling me? I don’t remember giving you permission to do that.
lines.zh: : 因为你居然给我打电话？我不记得允许过你这么做。

lines.en: : {i}I didn’t realize I needed permission.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不知道还需要许可。{/i}

lines.en: : Well...what do you want?
lines.zh: : 好吧……你想干嘛？

lines.en: : {i}Why didn’t you ever go back to the inn last night?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你昨晚为什么没回旅馆？{/i}

lines.en: : You realize I could ask you the same exact question, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我也可以问你一模一样的问题吧？

lines.en: : {i}Maya-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Maya-{/i}

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup17
: {i}Why the fuck do you think I never went back?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你觉得我他妈是为什么没回去？{/i}

lines.en: : I obviously wasn’t acting like myself. I was...sick. Or something.
lines.zh: : 我显然不像平时的自己。我当时……病了。还是什么的。

lines.en: : Hello?
: {i}I think we should probably talk about what happened.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我觉得我们大概该谈谈发生的事。{/i}

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup18
: Ugh...I hate talking.
lines.zh: : 呃……我讨厌谈话。

lines.en: : {i}I can assure you I hate it just as much.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我可以向你保证，我同样讨厌。{/i}

lines.en: : I propose that we ignore it and go back to despising one another.
lines.zh: : 我提议我们干脆无视它，继续互相厌恶。

lines.en: : {i}That would certainly be the easiest route, wouldn’t it?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那肯定是最省事的路，不是吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Maya?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Maya？{/i}

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup19
: Yeah...uhh...I guess we can...{i}talk.{/i}
lines.zh: : 好吧……呃……我猜我们可以……{i}谈谈{/i}。

lines.en: : But I’m kind of-
lines.zh: : 不过我现在有点-

lines.en: : {i}Great. Be at the park by my house in an hour.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}很好。一小时后到我家附近的公园。{/i}

lines.en: : Wait. I-
lines.zh: : 等等。我-

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup20
: Sensei? Are you still there?
lines.zh: : Sensei？你还在吗？

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup21
: Did he seriously just hang up on me?
lines.zh: : 他真的就这么挂我电话了？

lines.en: : Hm? He? Did Sensei call?
lines.zh: : 嗯？他？Sensei 打电话了？

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup22
: Worse. He {i}hung up{/i} on me.
lines.zh: : 更糟。他{i}挂了{/i}我电话。

lines.en: : Is he okay? How did his business meeting go?
lines.zh: : 他没事吧？他的商务会议怎么样？

lines.en: : Business meeting? What business meeting?
lines.zh: : 商务会议？什么商务会议？

lines.en: : It was the excuse Touka gave for why he suddenly disappeared last night.
lines.zh: : 那是 Touka 为他昨晚突然消失编的借口。

lines.en: : And you believed it?
lines.zh: : 而你还真信了？

lines.en: : No. I just didn’t want to think about the alternative.
lines.zh: : 没有。我只是不想去想另一种可能。

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup23
: Hah...well, whatever the case, we suddenly have somewhere else we need to be. Hurry up and eat your lunch so we can go.
lines.zh: : 哈……好吧，不管怎样，我们突然有另一个地方要去了。快点把午饭吃完我们就走。

lines.en: : Oh, I’m not hungry. But you can take as much time as you need and-
lines.zh: : 哦，我不饿。不过你可以慢慢来-

lines.en: scene black
: Wait, where’d all of your food go? Weren’t there three full takoyaki boats right next to you a second ago?
lines.zh: : 等等，你那些食物都去哪儿了？刚才你旁边不是还有三整份章鱼烧船吗？

lines.en: : I’m done. Let’s go.
lines.zh: : 我吃完了。走吧。

lines.en: : Wow...One day, you’re going to tell me how you do that.
lines.zh: : 哇……总有一天你得告诉我你是怎么做到的。

lines.en: : Let’s focus on fixing the world first...
lines.zh: : 先专心修好这个世界吧……

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup24
: Tell me, Makoto...how large is this “shopping mall” exactly? My mother told me stories about them when I was younger, but I didn’t think I’d ever get to {i}see{/i} one.
lines.zh: : 告诉我，Makoto……这个「购物中心」到底有多大？我小时候母亲跟我讲过它们的故事，但我没想到自己能亲眼{i}看到{/i}一座。

lines.en: : I...wouldn’t get your hopes up too high. It’s not {i}that{/i} exciting. Though, I’m sure having Miku there will make it a lot more, um...{i}active{/i} than it would be otherwise.
lines.zh: : 我……不会抱太大期望。它没{i}那么{/i}好玩。不过，我相信有 Miku 在，会比平时……嗯……{i}热闹{/i}不少。

lines.en: : Splendid. I do hope Yasu doesn’t get lost along the way. It will be her first time riding a bus alone.
lines.zh: : 好极了。我真希望 Yasu 别在路上走丢。这还是她第一次独自坐巴士。

lines.en: : Sensei, if you don’t have anything else going on, why don’t you come with us?
lines.zh: : Sensei，要是你没什么别的事，干嘛不跟我们一起去？

lines.en: : When did you two get so close?
lines.zh: : 你们俩什么时候变得这么亲近了？

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup25
: When I realized Touka was a good person.
lines.zh: : 在我意识到 Touka 是个好人的时候。

lines.en: : And this sudden cheerful attitude...is that thanks to her as well?
lines.zh: : 还有这突如其来的开朗态度……也是因为她？

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup26
: Who knows?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？

lines.en: : Who {i}cares?{/i}
lines.zh: : 谁{i}在乎呢？{/i}

lines.en: : If you do come along, will you promise not to teach me any more fake commoner rituals like your exceedingly {i}hilarious{/i} vending machine chant?
lines.zh: : 如果你也来，能不能保证不再教我那些假扮平民的仪式，比如你那个{i}好笑到不行{/i}的自动售货机咒语？

lines.en: : I’ve got other plans, actually. Just made them while you two were out on the balcony.
lines.zh: : 我其实另有安排。就在你们俩在阳台上的时候刚定下的。

lines.en: : I see. Very well, then.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。那就好吧。

lines.en: : Tell Maya I said hello.
lines.zh: : 替我向 Maya 问好。

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup27
: {i}Maya?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Maya？{/i}

lines.en: : Is {i}that{/i} who you were with before Touka showed up last night?
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}就是昨晚 Touka 出现之前跟你在一起的人？

lines.en: : Thanks, Tomonori. I appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Tomonori。我真是谢谢你。

lines.en: scene makototoukawakeup28
: Of all the names, why did it have to be that one?!
lines.zh: : 这么多名字，为什么偏偏是那一个？！

lines.en: scene black
The three of us leave the apartment together, but head in different directions once we make it to the street.
lines.zh: 我们三个人一起离开公寓，但一走到街上就各奔东西。

lines.en: I’m still not sure what purpose this apartment will serve in my life considering I don’t plan on uprooting everything and just...keeping it here instead, but...
lines.zh: 我仍然不确定这套公寓在我的人生里会扮演什么角色，毕竟我不打算把一切都连根拔起、就这么把它们搁在这儿，不过……

lines.en: It might be nice having somewhere quiet that no one really knows about.
lines.zh: 有个没人知道的安静去处，也许挺好的。

lines.en: Well, no one other than Makoto and Touka.
lines.zh: 好吧，除了 Makoto 和 Touka 没人知道。

lines.en: But those two are different from the rest of the class.
lines.zh: 但那两个人和班上其他人不一样。

lines.en: And I’m not sure if there is any amount of weight I could place on them that would cause them to break or bend.
lines.zh: 我也不确定，我能在她们身上压上多重的分量，才会让她们折断或弯曲。

$ makoto_love += 1
$ touka_love += 1
{i}Makoto’s affection has increased to [makoto_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Makoto 的好感度提升到了 [makoto_love]!{/i}

lines.zh: {i}Touka 的好感度提升到了 [touka_love]!{/i}
